reviews.x: I don't have enough hair to need a hair pick.  I read a tip that said these work great as a gizmo to hold vegetables while slicing.  The tip is correct, these are a fantastic kitchen tool.  Push a hair pick through an onion, make one slice between each tine, then slide the onion off for perfect burger onion slices.  Rotate the pick 90 degrees and slice again for chopped onions.  The tines are stainless steel so they won't rust and are easy to clean.
Great hair pic to use for slicing onions and firm tomatoes.

I love the way customers are repurposing this hair pick as a veggie slicer. Since three come to a pack, you can allocate one for hair, one for onions, and one for tomatoes.  My purpose in purchasing this set was for my son to groom his afro. He prefers this short and stout pick to the [[ASIN:B0030UL056 longer]] and thinner picks (see pic 1 for size comparison.) Bought this for a "hack" I saw on the Internet to hold onions, tomatoes, and other fruits and vegetables secure while you dice and slice and chop. Works perfect. Very sturdy and long. Great choice.

Cute and does exactly what it should.  I purchased this comb for my son a few months ago and it is still holding up well.  It is of good quality.  The plastic handle is attractive and strong and the metal teeth are all still intact.  I would recommend to others.

Item came packaged well. I thought the price was great for three Afro picks. I like the old-school look with power fist raised. Takes me back to the '70's. I gave the product 4 stars as these are stocking stuffers for three kids wearing 'naturals' so we'll see how they work out when put to use.

The wires are strong and act as the weft of the band.  I then wrap fibers up and down in a weaving fashion (for the warp) to see how my ideas and colors will turn out before I actually weave my band.

claims.text: Many reviewers buy these as a kitchen hack for holding onions, tomatoes, and other vegetables while slicing, and say it works well.
Reviewers who use them on hair report they work well for afros and naturals, with strong metal teeth that hold up over time.
Some reviewers report durability problems, with teeth falling out or rusting with use.
Buyers consider the three-pack a good value and like the old-school look.
A few reviewers use the picks for non-standard purposes like weaving or as gifts, and find them sturdy and effective.
